name: Fixed One-Corner Source with a Disconnected Placement Fibre
definition: For the certified 291-concept cornerless seed $G$, the acquired-support mask 2312 has exactly five ample one-concept extensions, at words $2184,2696,3720,3818,3822$. Their adjacency graph is the path $2184-2696-3720$ together with the edge $3818-3822$.
parameters: The five outside placements have seven shattered supports, so their placement fibre is disconnected and is not ample. The source $S=G\cup\{2696\}$ has 292 concepts and VC dimension three.
properties: $S$ is an ample forbidden pc-minor with unique corner 2696 and lies outside the proper-row common-seed cover class. Its only adjacent ample additions are 2568, 2184, and 3720; all are nonpeelable, with complete deletion certificates of respectively three, five, and four states. Since 2696 has two same-support companions, the VC-three one-corner theorem uniformly excludes every resolving neighbor.
